pages.text: Death cannot break a Mountaineer's loyalty. When one of your Mountaineers falls and cannot be revived while you wear the Nameless Set, it rises again as a Zombie Mountaineer, slower yet still able to scale sheer cliffs with its iron ice axe. Slaying hostile Mountaineers with a Necro Bolt also drags them back as your undead servant.
An undead Mountaineer that refuses to rest.
